description: Reactive fetch authentication for Solid-OIDC and W3C Linked Web Storage: upgrade requests with credentials after a 401, inside an explicit credential boundary.
rules: Always construct ReactiveFetchManager with an explicit CredentialBoundary listing the storages that may receive credentials.
Import custom elements from @solid/reactive-authentication/elements or registerElements; the main entry point has no DOM dependency.
Supply a namespace (and a SessionFence with a persistent store) whenever credential caches or session stores are persisted.
Use allowInsecureRequests / allowInsecureHttp only for local development servers.
